title: Import data peserta ke Google Contacts
author: Hendy Irawan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.f8ybrxw

steps.title: Open Gmail Contacts
steps.instruction: Open Gmail, click the Contacts icon, and ensure you are in the original Google Contacts view. If you are in the Contacts preview version, first click More > Import to switch to the original version, then in the original view click More > Import.

substeps.instruction: Open Gmail and navigate to Contacts.
If using the preview version, click More > Import to switch to the original Google Contacts.
In the original Google Contacts view, click More > Import.

steps.title: Import CSV file
steps.instruction: Select the prepared CSV file containing the participant data, click Import, and wait until the import process finishes.

substeps.instruction: Choose the CSV file that has been prepared for Google Contacts.
Wait for the import to complete.

steps.title: Merge duplicate contacts
steps.instruction: If duplicate contacts appear, click More > Find & merge duplicates, then click Merge to clean up the contact list.

substeps.instruction: Click Merge to resolve duplicate entries.
